description: LAB advisories for the simulated `simnos` images. Identifiers are lab-only (LAB-ADV-*), not real CVEs; a deployment replaces this file with its vendor's feed.

advisories.summary: BGP UPDATE with a malformed attribute can reset the session (remote, unauthenticated peer).
gNMI Subscribe with many paths can exhaust management-plane memory.
